name: God Helmet: modulated 40 Hz both sides, then amygdala left (60 min)
origin: Todd Murphy (Shiva God Helmet software); signal templates licensed from Persinger & Koren
summary: Todd Murphy's two-phase Shiva God Helmet session, 30 + 30 min: the 'modulated 40 Hz' signal stepped around both temporal lobes, then the amygdala burst-firing signal around the left one. The vendor says it works like the chirp version (presence, elation, joy, imagery) but is 'more likely to elicit psychic phenomena'. The one lab run (3 people, no sham) reports no clear pattern of experiences (Collins 2014, ch. 4).
notes: The vendor's general rule is 20 to 30 min per phase (index.htm). Persinger's lab ran this session once: 20 + 20 min, 3 people, no sham, no clear pattern of experiences (Collins 2014, ch. 4, condition 2; program persinger-collins-gh-c2-mod40bi-amyl). This file runs 30 + 30 min. Neither vendor signal is published, so both are rebuilt. Modulated 40 Hz: a 40 Hz sine whose phase swings by up to 3 rad every 2 s (invented). The vendor says only 'This signal has a constant tone' (obe45_consent.htm) and 'almost in sync with the brain's own binding factor, but not quite' (koren_mod40.htm); that program uses 5 Hz phase modulation. Amygdala: this project's rising sweep (6 to 30 Hz) with the published point duration and length, 289 points of 3 ms = 867 ms, then 4 s of silence (Collins 2014 p.40 [31]); the point values were never published. 'Amygdala' is the vendor's signal name, not a place the coils can single out. In phase 1 one left-right pair is on at a time, and the right side is reversed so that the pair's field points through the head. The four sites per side stand for the lab helmet's four solenoids per side on a 7.5 by 5 cm ellipse; the site names are this project's reading. Each coil is held 125 ms, a project choice (vendor: 'several times per second'). No God Helmet page states a field; the lab measured 1 to 2 uT in the centre of the cap (Collins 2014 p.69 [60]). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). The vendor marks this session experimental: if anger appears during or after it, never reuse it. Not for people prone to anger. Vendor exclusions: epilepsy or seizures, psychiatric conditions or medication, migraine, brain injury, drugs. Stop on any distress.
setting: Darkness and acoustic silence (the vendor: 'silence, not just quiet'), blindfold or eyes closed; sit or lie relaxed without meditating or falling asleep. The vendor prefers night sessions on geomagnetically quiet days and a helper who can stop the session. No meditation, mind machines or drugs at the same time.
schedule: Vendor rules: God Helmet sessions at most weekly; after six sessions, stop for 21 days (the vendor's God Helmet safety page). For 60-minute sessions the Shiva pages say weekly or every two weeks and the Shakti pages at most every 3 weeks; the longer gap is the cautious choice. The rule 'NEVER do the same session two days in a row' is from the vendor's Shakti pages. Do not mix with Shiva or Shakti sessions in the same weeks; try a session 2 to 3 times before changing it.
